name: an equal-cost path with fewer hops replaces one found earlier
why: s-a-b-t costs 0 + 0 + 0.5 and s-c-t costs 0.5 + 0. Dijkstra settles a and b (cost 0) before c (cost 0.5), so t is first reached through b with 3 hops; when c is settled the same cost arrives in 2 hops and must replace it.

queries.why: Both routes cost 0.5; the two-hop one wins.
